name: Extract Structured Data
description: Pull fields out of documents, scans and receipts into JSON or a table: you name the fields, every value is checked and traced to its source.
abilities: Agrees the fields and their types with you before extracting
Extracts from PDFs, Word files, spreadsheets, scans, receipts and pasted text
Leaves a value empty rather than guessing, and notes where each one came from
Checks the result with validate.py and saves it as JSON, CSV or an Excel table
permissions: Uses the Documents, Spreadsheets and OCR plugins to read sources, and the Code Sandbox to check results
